Summary

Dharrah EHS Consultancy is an environmental, health, and safety consultancy for industrial and infrastructure projects. The company supports regulatory approvals, environmental documentation, pollution control systems, monitoring-related work, wastewater treatment, ESG reporting, and carbon accounting.

Smart biogas plants and waste-to-energy

Dharrah EHS supplies fully automated, prefabricated Smart Biogas Plants that convert organic waste into purified biogas (LPG replacement), clean electricity, and organic bio-fertilizer through anaerobic digestion.

- Plug-and-play prefabricated design with rapid on-site installation
- IoT-enabled 24x7 monitoring of gas production, pressure, efficiency, and savings
- Integrated multi-stage gas purification (moisture, H2S, and odour removal)
- Up to 150% higher gas production efficiency and up to 70% less fresh water than conventional systems
- Odour-free sealed digestion and automatic feed, agitation, and temperature control
- Accepted feedstock: kitchen and canteen waste, vegetable and fruit peels, bakery and fast food waste, meat, poultry, fish, eggshells, garden waste, agro-residues, and cow dung
- Standard 500 kg/day unit: 20-25 kg LPG equivalent per day, 120-150 kg organic slurry per day, 20 ft x 30 ft footprint, MS build with epoxy and internal FRP coating
- Track record: 500+ running projects across 15+ cities and over 25,000 tons of organic waste processed
- Deployed for municipal corporations, defence facilities (Indian Army, Navy, Air Force), educational institutions, and industrial groups including Reliance, Adani, L&T, and ONGC
- Patented multi-feed BioCNG and slurry-fertilizer technology with national awards for zero-waste innovation
